subject: Recap: SlateBridge usage shape & hosted API pricing asks
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Dana Kim <dana@slatebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: SlateBridge discovery — next steps on numbers

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the run-through today. Quick recap from our side and the asks we have to firm up a hosted pricing proposal: 

- Confirmed product surface: conversational API for user-facing chat + periodic batch embeddings for search reindex.
- Missing items: monthly token volume (avg & distribution), 99th/peak TPS window, expected request shape (short vs long contexts), and any SSO/SLA constraints.

From the call I captured the following preliminary signals you gave: 
- Pilot target: ~2–3M monthly active users (mostly short prompts, median 40 tokens).
- Peak spike on launches: ~15–25 TPS for sustained 2–5 minute windows.

Can you attach the traffic spreadsheet you mentioned and confirm: 
1) expected monthly tokens (low/likely/high)
2) 99th percentile TPS during peak campaigns
3) target $/1M tokens (we can iterate on bands)

If easier, reply inline and we’ll convert to a pricing slab + a burst capacity add-on.

I attached a one-page pricing checklist and a sample SOW draft for reference. Next step from our side: Marissa will sketch two pricing scenarios (conservative + aggressive) once we have the numbers.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing_checklist.pdf, sow_draft_v1.pdf
From: Dana Kim <dana@slatebridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SlateBridge discovery — next steps on numbers

Sergio —

Thanks for the summary and for sending the SOW. Attaching the traffic profile (spreadsheet) — it has current week-by-week token estimates and an anticipated campaign spike in October. Quick answers inline: 

1) Monthly tokens (estimates in spreadsheet):
   - Low: 45M tokens/mo
   - Expected: 120M tokens/mo
   - High: 340M tokens/mo (if both product launches go well)
2) 99th percentile TPS during peak: 18–24 TPS for 3–7 minutes during launches; sustained 8–10 TPS during high-traffic days.
3) Target $/1M tokens: internally we’re looking for price near $650/1M tokens for hosted (aiming to keep unit cost sub-$0.001 for us).

Also flagged in the sheet: ~12% of requests require longer context (600–1500 tokens) for follow-up threads.

Let me know if you need any more columns in the sheet.

Cheers,
Dana Kim
Head of Product Ops | SlateBridge
dana@slatebridge.com

Attachment: slatebridge_traffic_profile.xlsx
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Dana Kim <dana@slatebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SlateBridge discovery — next steps on numbers

Dana —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the sheet, that’s super helpful. High-level observations for alignment: 

- Expected volume band (120M) maps to a mid-tier hosted slab; we can model a multi-band discount curve that gets more aggressive at ~300M+.
- Peak TPS (~24 for spikes) is in a range where we recommend a burst overlay (reserved baseline + short burst allowance) to avoid over-provisioning.
- Long-context mix (12%) will materially affect token pricing for those calls — we’ll call those out separately in the SOW as a premium-class call.

Marissa / Karthik — can you draft two scenarios for Dana: 
A) Conservative: 45M base + burst capacity for launches; unit $/1M = $820
B) Aggressive: 120M commit with month-to-month uplift bands; unit $/1M = $700, with dedicated burst credits for launch windows

Also include a third-line note about how we handle long-context calls (e.g., KV cache + prefix-trimming guidance to cut cost).

Dana — would you be open to a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the pricing slab, or prefer an annotated doc we send first?

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@slatebridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Dana Kim <dana@slatebridge.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SlateBridge discovery — next steps on numbers

Sergio / Dana —

Quick confirmation from my side (PM partner on the integrations team):
- The expected monthly token number we’ll commit to for pilot+Q4 runway is 120M tokens/mo.
- Peak TPS we need to plan engineering for: 22 TPS (we’ll budget for 24 as safety).
- Our target cost that we’d like to stay under for hosted: $650/1M tokens. If you can include an optional clause for transient burst credits that would help.

One ask: can Redwood provide a short note on observability (per-route token counts + latency percentiles) so our infra team can align on SLAs?

Thanks — Tom
Tom Reyes
Senior Product Manager | SlateBridge
Tom.Reyes@slatebridge.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@slatebridge.com>, Dana Kim <dana@slatebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SlateBridge discovery — next steps on numbers

Tom / Dana —

Perfect, thanks for confirming — that is enough for us to sketch firm pricing scenarios. Next steps and owners: 

- Marissa: deliver detailed pricing slab (Conservative / Aggressive + burst overlay) by EOD Monday (owner: Marissa Cole).
- Karthik: add a short appendix describing cost mitigation tactics for long-context calls and recommended quantization/embedding batch sizes (owner: Karthik Iyer).
- Sergio: send a 30-minute walkthrough invite for Tuesday and include the sample SOW with an explicit pricing appendix.

Tom — re: observability, we’ll attach a short note describing per-route token breakdowns, latency percentiles, and per-request tracing hooks. If you prefer, Karthik can hop on the call to run through it with your infra team.

I’m linking the HubSpot deal and the call recording here: https://hubspot.com/deal/7321 and https://drive.redwood.com/rec/recording/slatebridge-2026-08-18

If these next steps look good I’ll send the SOW v1 with the two pricing bands and the burst add-on attached.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Attachments: sow_draft_v1.pdf
